race.comment: KEN'KER (1) hit the frame two starts ago at Port Macquarie, then ran below par last time when sixth over 1000m at Taree after being in contention on the bend. Has the talent to figure prominently. JUST ONE LOOK (6) finished sixth two runs back then improved last start but found a couple better when third over 1210m at Port Macquarie. Best figures measure up. Sure to run well. COOL AZ ALETTA (4) was ridden quietly then made a little ground and finished sixth last time out over 1010m at Port Macquarie when resuming from a spell. Steps up in distance today and can play a leading role. POSH ANNIE (11) missed the placings two runs back then didn't do any better last start when eleventh over 1200m at Newcastle. Best efforts measure up so worth another chance.
